title: The differentiated lifted current has no spatial derivative loss after covariant integration by parts

current_identity.fields: Set psi_n=Q^n phi, pi_n=D_t psi_n and j_n^a=e Im<psi_(n+1),D^a psi_n> on the smooth periodic core.
current_identity.differentiation: partial_t j_n^a=e Im<pi_(n+1),D^a psi_n>+e Im<psi_(n+1),D^a pi_n>+e Im<psi_(n+1),[D_t,D^a]psi_n>.
current_identity.integration_by_parts: For real periodic A, int A_a Im<psi_(n+1),D^a pi_n>=-int (partial^a A_a)Im<psi_(n+1),pi_n>-int A_a Im<D^a psi_(n+1),pi_n>.
current_identity.commutator: The last differentiated-current term is algebraic in the electric curvature because [D_t,D_a] is charge times F_(ta); it contains no derivative of pi_n.
current_identity.tame_bound: If H_n is K1563's positive quadratic covariant graph energy and m>0, then |int A dot partial_t j_n|<=C_m B_A(t)sqrt(H_n H_(n+1)), where B_A=|e|(||A||_infinity+||div A||_3)+e^2||A||_infinity||E||_infinity. Sobolev H1->L6 controls the divergence term.
current_identity.normal_form_size: The correction itself obeys |M_n|=|int A dot j_n|<=C_m|e|||A||_infinity sqrt(H_n H_(n+1)).
current_identity.advance: The K1558/K1563 differentiated-current remainder loses no spatial derivative after integration by parts, but both it and M_n retain one adjacent charge tier.
current_identity.scope_guard: This is a smooth-core tame estimate in the fixed temporal-gauge convention. It does not make M_n gauge invariant, remove the adjacent charge tier, prove same-tier coercivity, keep an analytic radius positive, or complete the full PDE flow.
